markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (53%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu holds 42% and shares the conformal set; invasive is 4% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 53%, InSitu 42%, Invasive 4% | Close two-way call |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (α 0.1) | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.87 / 58th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Benign | Mostly supports Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Scarce here; lowers invasive association · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 2, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Prominent; lowers invasive association · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score; relevant to in situ · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; weak push toward invasive · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) spans 0: unproven. Normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 0's per-region risk is 96%; the 4% whole-image figure may understate it.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0** — top invasive contribution; look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 9** — atypical cells within ducts (Weak check); consider deeper levels.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4, 8, 9** — margin call flags tumor at these edges [F7]; verify.
